blocks.arabic_text: تَقْرَءُونَ هذِهِ اْلآيَةَ: (يآأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ امَنُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ ۚ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ مَنْ ضَلَّ إِذَا اهْتَدَيْتُمْ۞) (المائدة:١٠٥). وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ النَّاسَ إِذَا رَأَوُا الظَّالِمَ فَلَمْ يَأْخُذُوا عَلي يَدَيْهِ أَوْشَكَ أَنْ يَعُمَّهُمُ اللهُ بِعِقَابٍ مِنْهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث صحيح، باب ما جاء في نزول العذاب اذا لم يغير المنكر، رقم:٢١٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) said, “O people! You recite the ayah (يآأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ امَنُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ ج لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ مَنْ ضَلَّ إِذَا اهْتَدَيْتُمْ) “O you who have Iman! Take care of yourselves; while you are on the right path, those who have gone astray will cause you no harm.” I have heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “If people see an oppressor committing oppression and do not stop him from oppression, the day is not far when Allah Ta'ala will seize all of them in His general punishment.”” Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of what Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) said is: you think that the meaning of this ayah is that if a person is on the right path, the work of enjoining good and forbidding evil is not necessary for him, because he will not be questioned about others. But Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA), by relating this hadith, has refuted this wrong interpretation of the ayah. He made it clear that stopping evil as far as possible is a responsibility upon every one of this Ummah, and that it is also the duty of every individual. The correct interpretation of the ayah is: O you who have Iman! Be concerned about your own reform. Your reforming yourselves on the path of Din should be while paying attention to the reform of others
